data.name: Painful Stare
data.description: When an attack that deals damage hits the target of a mesmerist's hypnotic stare, the mesmerist can cause the target to take %1 additional damage. The mesmerist can use this ability as a free action, and can use it even if it isn't his turn.|PainfulStareDam

raw_tokens.value: When an attack that deals damage hits the target of a mesmerist's hypnotic stare, the mesmerist can cause the target to take %1 additional damage. The mesmerist can use this ability as a free action, and can use it even if it isn't his turn.|PainfulStareDam
If the mesmerist uses this ability to increase his own damage, the additional damage increases by %1d6 points.|PainfulStareBonusDice|PREVARGTEQ:PainfulStareBonusDice,1

This damage is precision damage and is not multiplied on a critical hit. A mesmerist can trigger this ability only once per round, but a single creature can take damage from multiple mesmerists' painful stares in a round.
